description: This file contains test cases for the ExecSkillBinTrust functionality in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing trust index resolution and skill auto-allow conditions related to skill binary paths.

classes.name: ExecSkillBinTrustTests
classes.description: A struct containing test methods for verifying skill binary trust index resolution and auto-allow logic in the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: build trust index resolves skill bin paths
methods.description: Test that the trust index correctly resolves skill binary paths.

methods.name: skill auto allow accepts trusted resolved skill bin path
methods.description: Test that auto-allow logic correctly accepts a trusted skill binary path.

methods.name: skill auto allow rejects same basename at different path
methods.description: Test that auto-allow rejects a skill binary with the same basename found at different paths.

methods.name: makeExecutable
methods.description: Creates a temporary executable file with specified name for testing purposes.

methods.name: makeReport
methods.description: Constructs a simulated SkillsStatusReport with specified skill binary names.
